references.title: Labor Code (PD 442) art.296: probationary employment shall not exceed six months from the date the employee started working; an employee allowed to work after the probationary period is a regular employee.

Republic Act No. 12063 (Enterprise-Based Education and Training Framework Act) s.4: an apprentice contract records an APPRENTICESHIP programme; a trainee contract records GENERAL training or UPSKILLING.

Omnibus Rules Implementing the Labor Code, Book III Rule VIII s.4(d): wages shall not be paid in a bar, night or day club, drinking establishment, massage clinic, dance hall or gaming place unless the employee is employed there.

Labor Code art.82 (field personnel) and PD 851 Revised Guidelines (task-basis and piece-rate work): statutory work category, with RA 10361 (kasambahay, DOMESTIC), RA 11965 (CAREGIVER) and NIRC s.33(A) (supervisory staff, SUPERVISORY, inside the fringe benefit tax); NIRC ss.22(E)-(G), 24(A) and 25(A)-(B): residency status selects the graduated or final withholding table.

validate:
const hours = get(get(ctx.entry, 'terms', {}), 'normal_hours_per_day', null);
return hours >= ctx.lookup.minimum_daily_hours && hours <= ctx.lookup.maximum_daily_hours;

references.title: Labor Code art.83: the normal hours of work shall not exceed eight hours a day; a compressed workweek may lengthen the normal day but not beyond twelve hours (DOLE Department Advisory No. 02-04).

DOLE Labor Advisory No. 06-20: final pay shall be paid within thirty calendar days from the date of separation, unless a more favourable company policy or individual/CBA agreement provides a shorter period.

validate:
const facts = get(ctx.entry, 'entity_extension_data', {});
return ctx.lookup.required_declarations.every((name) => get(facts, name, null) !== null);

references.title: NPC Circular No. 2022-04, ss.5-7: registration scope, likely-risk processing and automated decision-making or profiling declarations.
BIR Revenue Regulations No. 11-2018, ss.2.79(B)(5) and 2.83.1: the BIR Form 2316 follows the last compensation payment and identifies the employee and the compensation period.
BIR Revenue Regulations No. 11-2018, ss.2.79(B)(5) and 2.83.1: the BIR Form 2316 follows the last compensation payment; its delivery is evidenced by the furnished certificate.

Labor Code art.83 and DOLE Department Advisory No. 02-04: the normal hours of work do not exceed eight hours a day, and a compressed workweek may lengthen the normal day but not beyond twelve hours. Labor Code art.91: a rest day of at least twenty-four consecutive hours after six consecutive normal work days. Roster warnings record these caps without refusing the entry; no daily or monthly overtime cap is recorded for the Philippines.

RA 6727 s.2 and the Regional Tripartite Wages and Productivity Board wage orders: the daily minimum wage depends on the region and the establishment's agriculture/non-agriculture/retail classification; domestic workers have a separate wage table. DOLE/BWC wage order summaries, read 2026-10-31.
A no-pay entry or its reversal is dated in the period that will pay it. A correction to a period already paid is a reversal entry on the same catalog item, dated in the next period to run.
